title: Superhuman email section
description: A product section on the light page: centred lockup, two-tone headline (second line in grey), lead and buttons, then an asymmetric bento: one tall purple tile on the left (media above, text below) and two stacked tiles on the right (deep indigo and stone). On phones all three tiles stack with the media on top.
notes: purple and indigo tiles are deep surfaces (chart-4, chart-3) with light text
